J_exec: J_nom*(1+cost_overrun); arithmetic expansion of individually authored values
cost_overrun: signed dimensionless ratio, greater than -1 for positive execution cost
max_deviation_m: nonnegative hypothetical maximum aligned planar deviation in metres
median: average of central two sorted values for even n
coverage: number of rows with error <= threshold divided by row count
manual_input_format: one row: J_nom|overrun_percent|max_deviation_mm|cost_assessment|geometry_assessment; values are explicitly authored, not generated by formula or RNG
